cv.text: Saudi operations director with twenty years of experience from 2006 to 2026 in data analysis, service development and multidisciplinary leadership. segments.text: Wadi Product Studio seeks a Product operations director to lead operational improvement and service measurement. Responsibilities include weekly reporting, performance indicators, handover coordination, training and exception review. The role requires at least ten years of experience, clear communication, requirements analysis and change management. The team is based in Riyadh and collaborates with colleagues in Jeddah and Dammam. Prepare evidence of team leadership, faster reporting and data quality improvement, plus a practical plan for the first ninety days.
